subject: Post-demo: Atlas Retail — fit check & proposed pilot next step
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Atlas Retail — fit check & proposed pilot next step

Hi Sam —

Really appreciated the time today. Quick recap from our demo and the items I promised to put in writing: 

- Primary goal: reduce inference tail latency for chat scoring and product-recommendation reranking (target < 150ms p95 for 256 token prompts).
- Current infra: GCP us-west1, customer-managed VPC; sensitive PII in some payloads (need encryption-at-rest + audit logs).
- Success metrics you mentioned: latency, per-session cost under $0.10, and stable throughput during peak (200 rps).

What I recommend as a next step (low-risk pilot):
1) 4-week pilot on Redwood Dedicated with a scoped dataset and two model configs (fp16 and 4-bit quantized) to measure latency/cost tradeoffs.
2) We spin up a sandbox cluster in your VPC, run a 1-day synthetic soak followed by a week of real-traffic evaluation.
3) Weekly check-ins and a short evaluation report covering p95, cost/token, and failure modes.

Attached: 20260815_Atlas_Discovery_Notes.pdf — summary of ops constraints and proposed pilot scope.

Ask: can you confirm whether this pilot aligns with your Q3 priorities and if we can target a kick-off window the week of Aug 31? If there are procurement or legal blockers, please flag them and we can route a lightweight SOW.

If now isn't a priority, no worries — a quick note works fine. Otherwise, I can follow up with calendar slots.

Thanks again —
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri***@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Sam —

Final quick touch before I close out my notes for the quarter. I don't want to fill your inbox if this isn't a current priority, so two options:

- "Yes, let's schedule" — I can send 3 calendar slots and an outline SOW for an Aug/Sept pilot.
- "Not right now" — reply "deprioritize" and I'll follow up in Q4.

One additional datapoint that might help: for similar retailers we ran a 3-week sandbox and saw a 40% reduction in p95 and a 30% per-token cost improvement by switching to a 4-bit quantized variant and autoscaling policy. Happy to share the short case note if useful.

If I don't hear back, I'll mark this as deprioritized and check in again in mid-Oct. Thanks for considering —
